            Cheeky flamingo breaks out of Paignton zoo for late-night trip to Morrisons petrol station

            The bird was eventually caught outside a Spar shop

            Comments1
            News
            Maxine Denton
            13:08, 25 Nov 2026
            Listen to audio version of this article
            Sponsored by
            0:00 / 2:01
            Instaread

            Locals were treated to an unusual site at a petrol station in South Devon after a flamingo escaped from a zoo and decided "he needed to see these fuel prices for himself".

            ‌
            ‌

            Paignton Zoo said one of its Chilean flamingos managed to escape from the site and headed over the road to what is understood to be a Morrisons petrol station.

            ‌

            In a humorous post shared on Facebook about the escape, Paignton Zoo said its team were able to respond quickly to get the pink bird back as soon as possible, thanks to the help of members of the public who reported it.

            ‌

            Live Nation slams Cornwall venue The Wylde's 'remote' location in £1 million legal clash

            Torquay madness as husband shoots BB gun as wife drives BMW into pedestrians

            A spokesperson wrote: "You may have seen that last night we had an unexpected escapee, one of our Chilean flamingos decided he needed to see these fuel prices for himself and adventured over the road to the petrol station!

            "Firstly, we want to say thank you to everyone who reported the sighting to the police and the zoo, this meant that our team could respond to the scene quickly and get the flamingo back to the zoo as soon and as safely as possible.

            ‌

            "We are delighted to say the flamingo is unharmed and back on flamingo lake with his friends, with quite the story to tell at breakfast this morning!"

            Don't let an algorithm decide what Devon news you see - click here to add DevonLive as your preferred Google source.

            ‌

            The zoo said the bird was eventually caught by its Rainforests team outside of a Spar shop before it was safely returned to the flamingo lake.

            It said: "A huge well done to our Rainforests team for responding so quickly and calmly, catching up a flamingo outside Spar was likely not in their evening plans so thank you to everyone involved.

            Article continues below

            "We are reviewing the circumstances surrounding the incident to help prevent a repeat adventure."
